name: Bo kho
summary: Bò khô is dried beef from the weekend market’s dried-food stalls. The center stall also sells smoked beef, thịt bò hun khói, a provincial three-star OCOP product.
origin: Mang Den weekend market, among the dried foods.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
The market’s center stall sells the provincial three-star OCOP smoked pork, smoked beef, and smoked buffalo, with wine products and specialty salt.
seoDescription: Bò khô, dried beef, and three-star OCOP smoked beef at the Mang Den weekend market.
